fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.help: The name of the Availability Zone (AZ) where the odb network is located.

fields.label: Availability Zone ID
fields.help: The AZ ID of the AZ where the ODB network is located.

fields.label: Backup Subnet Cidr
fields.help: The CIDR range of the backup subnet for the ODB network.

fields.label: Client Subnet Cidr
fields.help: The CIDR notation for the network resource.

fields.label: Cross Region S3 Restore Sources Access
fields.help: The list of regions enabled for cross-region restore in the ODB network.

fields.label: Custom Domain Name
fields.help: The name of the custom domain that the network is located.

fields.label: Default DNS Prefix
fields.help: The default DNS prefix for the network resource.

fields.label: Delete Associated Resources
fields.help: If set to true deletes associated OCI resources.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The user-friendly name for the odb network.

fields.label: KMS Access
fields.help: Specifies the configuration for Amazon KMS access from the ODB network.

fields.label: KMS Policy Document
fields.help: Specifies the endpoint policy for Amazon KMS access from the ODB network.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: S3 Access
fields.help: Specifies the configuration for Amazon S3 access from the ODB network.

fields.label: S3 Policy Document
fields.help: Specifies the endpoint policy for Amazon S3 access from the ODB network.

fields.label: Sts Access
fields.help: Specifies the configuration for Amazon STS access from the ODB network.

fields.label: Sts Policy Document
fields.help: Specifies the endpoint policy for Amazon STS access from the ODB network.

fields.label: Zero Etl Access
fields.help: Specifies the configuration for Zero-ETL access from the ODB network.

fields.help: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m".
